setup: Authored initial conditions only. Native production UI supplies all later player commands and simulation ticks. Group manifests retain each setup exception.

authored.map: Seed 0, small forest world with two layers; flat grass, no resources or neutral actors.
authored.calendar: Day, season and weather lengths are 1,000,000 seconds. Seed 0 starts in clear daylight.
authored.roster: Human side zero, external opponent; normal headquarters and distant workers retained. Default combat troops removed; encounter troops use native built-in definitions.
authored.undergroundWorker: One owned worker starts on level one; every import must preserve it.
authored.economy: Starting age three and starting banks of 2,000 wood, 2,000 ore and 500 crystal.
authored.cooldowns: Non-firing targets, guards, workers and formation troops start with cooldown 1,000. First-hit shooters start with cooldown 3. No cooldown is changed after recording.
authored.health: Normal definition health except the explicitly listed wounded cover or casualty actor.
authored.description: First native Boltspitter attack approaches a held Ironjaw from front. Independent fixtures prevent previous shots changing momentum or morale.
